description:
Halloween The Game Walkthrough Part 1 and until the last part will include the full Halloween Gameplay on PC. This Halloween Gameplay is recorded in 4K 60FPS on PC and will include the full game, all endings and all boss fights.

Huge thanks to Gun Interactive for providing me with an early copy!

Enjoy! 

If you liked the video please remember to leave a Like & Comment, I appreciate it a lot!

Story Mode - 00:00
Dr Loomis Boss Fight - 1:54:35
Full Ending - 2:06:27
Cornfield Ending - 2:10:56
Sewer Ending - 2:12:13

On Halloween night, 1978, no one is safe from Michael Myers. Become the Boogeyman or fight back against Michael Myers in Halloween. Immerse yourself in the haunting narrative events of "The Night He Came Home" through the eyes of Michael Myers in a standalone singleplayer story.
